layers.note: A herb of clearings, burns, road cuts and rocky open ground.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 2,000 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on steep, rocky slopes as well as flats.

coldest_c.note: Widespread through the temperate and boreal zones: coldest-month means from about −20 °C (gone by −30 °C) to about 16 °C.

warmest_c.note: Across its range, warmest-month means from about 8 to 26 °C; gone below 5 °C, where summers are too short, and above 30 °C.

degree_days_0.note: About 1,000 or more degree-days above 0 °C, none below 600.

degree_days_5.note: About 400 or more degree-days above 5 °C, none below 150.

moisture_index.note: A moisture index from about 0.3, gone by 0.2.

summer_rain.note: No limit: it grows under summer-dry and summer-wet climates alike.

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands; not yet checked against the public-domain USDA references (Silvics of North America, the Fire Effects Information System, PLANTS). Climate ranges (niche schema 2, 2026-10-06): Pearly everlasting grows across temperate and boreal North America and north-east Asia, to subalpine meadows (FEIS, the PLANTS Database). Each climate range brackets the climate of that range at the 2.8° ERA5 product's scale, an approximate envelope read from these descriptions, not fitted to occurrence records.
